checks.criterion: Sky Ranch phases convert into lot sales and water/wastewater tap fees
checks.evidence: Lot sales revenue rose 19% to $3.006 million year over year. The stored thesis cites $37.6 million of tap fees received through May 31, 2026, with more than $19.0 million estimated for Phase 2; the reported 66 water taps sold versus 40 a year earlier is directionally supportive.

checks.criterion: Lot deliveries are paced to builder absorption, limiting inventory carry
checks.evidence: The company expects approximately 159 Phase 2E lots in fiscal 2027, “paced to match builder absorption.”

checks.criterion: Phase 2D/2E timing remains on track; kill criterion is a slip of at least two quarters versus prior guidance
checks.evidence: Current guidance expects substantial Phase 2D completion by fiscal 2026 year-end and approximately 159 Phase 2E lots in fiscal 2027. The prior-release timing needed to test for a two-quarter slip was not provided.

checks.criterion: Taps sold do not stall for two consecutive quarters while Arapahoe County single-family permits fall more than 25% year over year
checks.evidence: 66 water taps were sold versus 40 in the year-ago quarter, but consecutive-quarter tap data and the relevant county permit comparison are not provided.

checks.criterion: Water and wastewater revenue declines year over year for two quarters as oil and gas water demand fades
checks.evidence: Water and wastewater revenue increased 119% to $4.659 million and deliveries rose to 631 acre-feet from 76. The company expects continued oil and gas water-sales demand for the remainder of 2026; two consecutive quarters of results are not available here.

checks.criterion: Oil and gas water sales provide a second source of water demand beyond housing
checks.evidence: The company expects continued oil and gas water-sales demand for the remainder of 2026, while water and wastewater revenue rose 119% year over year. The reported data do not quantify the oil and gas contribution.

checks.criterion: Rental portfolio adds recurring revenue, with 95% of units leased before completion
checks.evidence: The company expects the majority of 23 contracted additional rental homes to be available in calendar 2026. No current leasing percentage or rental revenue KPI is provided.

checks.criterion: Equity raise or new debt to fund development beyond existing facilities
checks.evidence: Cash and cash equivalents were $8.440 million versus $21.931 million, but the provided KPIs do not identify an equity raise, new debt, or whether development funding exceeds existing facilities.

data.summary: Reported quarterly results are directionally supportive: water and wastewater revenue, deliveries, taps sold, and lot sales all increased year over year, and current Phase 2 guidance is stated. None of the kill criteria can be confirmed from the provided data; timing comparisons, county permits, consecutive-quarter trends, and financing details remain untested.
